headline: Lionel Messi And Cristiano Ronaldo Lead Globe Soccer Award Nominees
metaDescription: Lionel Messi, Cristiano Ronaldo, and Kylian Mbappe headline the 2026 Globe Soccer Awards nominees list as public voting opens until November 30.
aiSummaryBullets: Lionel Messi, Cristiano Ronaldo, and Kylian Mbappe are among the primary nominees for the 2026 Globe Soccer Awards.
Arsenal and Paris Saint-Germain are featured in the shortlist for the Best Men's Club category.
The awards committee has opened the public voting phase, which is scheduled to conclude on November 30.
aiContextParagraph: The 2026 Globe Soccer Awards has released its official list of nominees across several categories, including individual player achievements and team performance. High-profile athletes such as Lionel Messi, Cristiano Ronaldo, Kylian Mbappe, Ousmane Dembele, and Lamine Yamal have been selected for nomination. In addition to player awards, the organization has identified contenders for the Best Men's Club title, with Arsenal and Paris Saint-Germain among those included in the competition. The recognition process involves a public participation component, which began on November 18 and will remain accessible to fans until the final day of the month. These awards are organized to acknowledge various contributions to global football, with the current phase focusing on gathering public input to determine the eventual winners of these honors.
whyItIsViral: This topic is generating moderate interest, supported by strong search activity and coverage across national news outlets regarding major football figures.
